audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0,1,2,4].side all say Skill and phases[6].side says Skill, but the content layer win[] (already correct against the packet chart: Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Neeko/Skill/Milio) and the packet's own levelChart disagree — Neeko should hold levels 1-3 and 6, Milio should hold 2+ items.
audit.why: Neeko's Tangle-Barbs (E) root plus Blooming Burst (Q) poke outrange Milio's melee kick pre-6, and Pop Blossom (R) off a landed root threatens a one-combo kill at level 6; Milio only takes over once his cleanse/heal/range-zone kit is online with items.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[0,1,2,4].side to Neeko and phases[6].side to Milio, rewriting each .why to match; phases[3] and [5] already agree with win[] and are left alone.

audit.why: Spikes are already well-placed: Neeko's level-2 root/poke, her level-6 Pop Blossom burst, and Milio's item-2 cleanse/heal/range spike are all named with real ability names.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Tangle-Barbs and the R but gives no real cooldown numbers (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted verbatim under unrelated titles (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and Pop Blossom (R) is 120/105/90s per the enemy kit — those numbers make the punish window concrete. The Do/Don't bullets need content that actually matches their titles instead of restating the trade rules.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers; rewrote dosFull[1].d to describe holding an E charge for the post-root burst, and dontsFull[2].d to describe walking up without tracking Tangle-Barbs.
